column1: # N1 (H1N1) neuraminidase functional sites. The sialidase active site is a highly
# conserved pocket formed by catalytic residues (that directly contact substrate)
# and framework residues (that stabilise the pocket). Standard references cite
# these in N2 numbering; here they are translated to the app's sequential N1
# numbering (H1N1 NA, 1-based) by aligning the app N1 consensus to N2. The
# renumbered 3NSS chains A-D share this numbering, so positions map 1:1.
